subject: Request for latest attack assessment + secure sharing options
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acme.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: josh.miller@acme.com
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: latest attack assessment + delivery options

Hi Lauren,

We're updating our SIG and CAIQ for an internal audit and need to include the most recent independent attack assessment you have for the hosted API. Specifically:

- The full assessment report (redacted if needed) or an executive summary if the full report is restricted
- A remediation tracker (status: open/closed, owners, dates) tied to the report findings
- Confirmation of the scope (hosted API endpoints, control plane, data-at-rest handling) that was tested

We have an evidence portal that accepts S3 presigned uploads or SFTP drops. If you prefer, we can sign an NDA and accept the report through DocuSign/secure portal.

Could you confirm:
1) latest test date and whether the full report is shareable to Acme under our existing PO/ToU, or if an NDA is required
2) preferred secure transfer method (presigned S3 / SFTP / vendor portal)
3) approximate delivery ETA if redacted vs full report

Thanks — we are on a tight window for the audit (targeting next-week review).

Emily Zhao
Senior Information Security Manager
Acme Cloud

---
Attachments: none (we will accept uploads to your preferred channel)

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acme.com>
Cc: josh.miller@acme.com
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest attack assessment + delivery options

Hi Emily — thanks for the note and the timeline. Happy to help. Quick answers up front:

- Latest independent assessment: 2026-09-14 (executed by Clearwater Security)
- We can provide a redacted full report and a remediation matrix immediately; the unredacted report requires an NDA signed by the requesting legal entity
- Transfer options we support: presigned S3 link (48h expiry, client-controlled MFA recommended), SFTP drop (longer retention), or upload to your evidence portal (we can push to a designated folder)

Proposed next steps:
1) I can share the redacted PDF + remediation_matrix CSV to your portal today if you confirm which method (reply with S3 / SFTP / portal + upload details)
2) If you need the unredacted report, please share an NDA contact or we can send our standard mutual-NDA via DocuSign — legal turnaround is typically 2–3 business days
3) I'll loop in our security team with a short internal ask to confirm item-level remediation status and any open CVEs that still have longer-term mitigations

For transparency: the high-level summary is included below and I can expand as needed in the remediation table.

High-level summary (for Acme audit):
- Critical findings: 0 open (all criticals fixed as of 2026-09-28)
- High: 2 findings (one in third-party dependency; one in optional admin console path) — mitigations shipped or planned with ETA in matrix
- Medium/low: several items tracked and closed in Q3 sprint cadence

If you confirm portal or S3, I'll push the redacted artifacts and CC our security reviewer (Rishi) so he can add any context.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood_pt_summary_2026-09.pdf (redacted executive summary)
Attachment: remediation_matrix_2026-09.csv

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2026 12:18:00 -07:00

Team — forwarding Acme's ask. They need the redacted report + remediation matrix to ingest into their SIG/CAIQ. Two quick asks for Rishi:

- Can you confirm the remediation_matrix rows (owner, status, closed_date) are up-to-date and safe to share?
- Any objections to sharing the redacted PDF to their portal/S3 if Acme confirms an upload destination? If NDA required for the unredacted, we should flag which sections need that restriction (tooling, raw logs, PII snippets).

Timing: they want this reviewed next week. I told them we could share redacted + matrix today if they give upload details.

Thanks — looping you all for a fast turnaround.

— Lauren

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: latest attack assessment + delivery options

Thanks for the ping, Lauren — summary below (copied from Security evidence repo). I reviewed the remediation matrix and confirm shareability for the redacted artifacts. Unredacted report: legal required.

Remediation summary (short):
- Critical: 0 open (fixed 2026-09-28)
- High: 2 items
  - CVE-2026-1122 (third-party dependency): patched in 2026-09-21 (release v2.4.7), verification tests green, owner: infra-team (Vivek)
  - Admin console insecure redirect: mitigated via config change and hardened routing, owner: product-security (Marissa), mitigation deployed 2026-09-18, queued for regression run this week
- Medium/low: 7 items — all closed or in standard release cycle, dates in remediation_matrix_2026-09.csv

Share guidance:
- Redacted PDF + remediation_matrix_2026-09.csv: OK to push to customer evidence portal or create a presigned S3 link (48h). Remove internal ticketing IDs in the shared matrix (we already redacted those).
- Unredacted report: send only after a signed NDA labeling the requestor entity. Per legal we will attach the standard confidentiality addendum.

Suggested delivery action: Lauren, if Acme confirms portal details, we'll push redacted PDF + CSV this morning and reply with the upload confirmation and the Drive/S3 path. If they prefer SFTP, provide the credentials and target path and we'll SFTP drop.

Notes for CS/Sales: please do not forward raw logs or host-level artifacts to external parties. If they request raw evidence for an audit, we'll route through a supervised upload and legal approval.

-Rishi Malhotra
Senior Manager, Security Assurance
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
